title: Domains and specifications of primitive integral realization
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, finite-field datum D, and canonical strict-system operations o [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], define the unary, tensor and compact-support domains by specializing Expression.domain [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. Define basicProperTower to require a specified SfIntegralDirectImage triangle whose projections equal the system-limit projections composed with direct-image evaluation and reduction evaluation. HasBasicRealizations is exactly the existing primitive comparison specification: a normalized RealizationModel, invertible reconstruction units on constructible inputs, published pullback and tensor model inverses, conjugate proper comparisons and defining Roos projections, the actual open mate and inverse output unit, and whole compact-support tower comparisons with all transitions and scalar-adjoint projection equations. This relocates the eight existing definitions verbatim; it adds no mathematical assumption.
